plugins.name: meters
plugins.description: Context window, 5-hour, weekly usage and the prompt cache countdown as compact meters in one band above the prompt or a side panel, with warnings, a going-cold notice and one-click handoff to a fresh session.

plugins.name: mods-manager
plugins.description: Keeps your mods current: pulls the mods folder from GitHub at session start (/updatemods to do it now), and a skill that installs mods you build.

plugins.name: plan-progress
plugins.description: Panel above the prompt for multi-step work and /goal: goal, phase, task checklist, progress bar, elapsed time, and a chime when a turn ends. Zero model calls.

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: A sparkle Enhance button and hotkey that rewrites your draft prompt in place: fitting skills, project details, decisions to ask you first, and what done looks like.

plugins.name: saver
plugins.description: Sends easy prompts to Haiku 5.5 while context is under 100K. A strip above the prompt (hidden unless saver just routed an answer; /saver strip changes that) shows the model and what was saved today.
